svg.aria-label: Results. RescueLens: 94.55% top-1 accuracy on 196 car classes; refused to guess on 58 of 60 unseen cars. Query2Diagnose: 0% unsafe answers on 300 cases, LLM baselines 43 to 70%. Voyance: 14 to 24% more expected profit than re-buying last year's bookings, in simulation. 790 automated tests across four projects (ULTRON 337, Neralu 287, RescueLens 94, Voyance 72). 10 hackathons and build sprints, 2 finales.
